name: search-bar
title: Search bar
what: One search box any app links: a hairline field that submits to the app's own results page, an optional suggest-as-you-type panel from the app's own endpoint, a top match the app learned from what people actually opened, and an optional smart pass the app computes. Empty, unconfigured and failed are drawn as three different states.

mount.element: #app-search (or any element with data-app-search); link the script WITHOUT defer, immediately after the mount

attributes.data-action: REQUIRED: the app's own search RESULTS page, where the form GETs. No action, no bar.
attributes.data-app: the app slug; keys this reader's saved recent searches and names the props record
attributes.data-app-name: the app's name, used in the label, the 'Popular in ...' heading and the fallback pre-text
attributes.data-value: the current query, so the box is filled in on a results page
attributes.data-sources: comma-separated list of what this app searches, composed into the pre-text
attributes.data-placeholder: an explicit pre-text; prefer data-sources or the endpoint's placeholder
attributes.data-suggest-url: optional: the APP's own JSON endpoint for suggest-as-you-type; without it there is no panel
attributes.data-chose-url: optional: the APP's own endpoint that receives the beacon when a suggestion is opened
attributes.data-min: characters before the first suggest request (default 2)
attributes.data-hotkey: the single key that focuses the bar (default /); Ctrl/Cmd-K always works
attributes.data-agent-powered: declare only when the app's search is model-assisted; draws a faint star
attributes.data-props: optional: the hub's component-properties route for this app

mount.slot: [data-search-fallback] inside the mount is the no-JS box (a plain input in a plain form); removed only once the component has rendered

contract.unconfigured: {"ok": false, "reason": "unconfigured", "error": "<what is missing, in a reader's words>"}
contract.smart: GET <suggest-url>?q=...&smart=1 -> the same shape, re-ranked by the app; optional smart_error when its pass could not run
contract.chose: POST <chose-url> {"q", "ref", "url", "kind", "rank"} -> {"ok": true}; CSRF from <body data-csrf>, a csrfmiddlewaretoken input, or a cookie whose name ends in csrftoken

rules: The hub serves this component and never an app's data: every URL on the mount is on the app's own origin, behind its own sign-in.
The component never calls a model and never invents a reason: `top`, `why` and the smart pass are the app's.
Nothing is learned from a query that was merely typed or run: the beacon fires only when a person opened a suggestion.
A suggest endpoint that answers HTML is reported as a failure, never parsed as an empty result.
The top match is lifted out of its group, never listed twice.
The pre-text never rotates; the endpoint's placeholder is applied once.

props.label: Search box pre-text
props.hint: Wins over the app's own and the suggest endpoint's. Blank keeps the app's.
